English:
We’ll be operating in conjunction with Black Bear team, a guerilla group specialized in anti-armor combat.

Black Bear consists of two standard infantry guys, along with two AT troops and one LAW soldier – their heavy weapons are scavenged from dead Russians.

We shouldn't meet any heavily-armored enemies – except that tank, of course. Black Bear should have enough heat to neutralize it. I hope.

And, of course, there’ll be lots of infantry. Which is where we come in.

Additional info

May 14, 1985 – They’re all dead! And I'm left here alone on Everon. Christ, I think this place is cursed.

The Russians almost got me – and I’m only alive now thanks to Slava and the rest of these guerilla guys. But God only knows what’s going to happen next. Apparently, we’re going on some kind of mission. Then we’ll meet up with the others and try to reach the main Resistance base.

Slava’s given me some info about the job ahead. Sounds completely crazy.

But maybe my luck’s gonna hold out. And at least these guys know what they’re fighting for…
Rescue
Use your binoculars to locate as many guards as you can in the village.
After the Black Bear force has neutralized the tank, assault the village with the rest of White Wolf. Don't let the hostages be harmed.
Load the hostages on to the truck and rendezvous with theother group. Black Bear will cover you.
Your task is to save the civilians. It's essential they survive.

The Russians are planning to kill a group of civilians – and it’s your job to stop them.

You’re temporarily a member of the guerilla force codenamed White Wolf, which lies in wait near this forest.
